summary: US CENTCOM confirmed two American soldiers killed and one missing in Jordan during Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks, the fourth such assault in five days. Iran's IRGC claimed targeting two additional vessels in the Strait of Hormuz while explosions struck Bandar Abbas port and airbase. The US evacuated its embassy facilities in Aqaba, Jordan, citing a credible threat, and the White House reportedly ordered CENTCOM to prepare aggressive military options against Iran. (Source: @VahidOnline/77247, @VahidOnline/77251, @rodast_omiddana/76855, @VahidOnline/77258, @rasedal3ado138e/378925, @pkpoi/143329)
